## MEDIUM-priority finding details

### M-1: `bd-belay-on` is not the only skill without a ticketing dependency  (1/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `skills/introduction.mdx:92` currently says `bd-belay-on` is "the only skill with no ticketing dependency at all".
- **Source**: `skills-source/plugin/skills/bd-kg-search/SKILL.md:1-63` — a direct knowledge-graph search with no tracker binding or Linear/Jira reference.

### M-2: MCP refresh-token lifetime not documented  (1/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `configuration/environment-variables.mdx:240-248` (`MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL`) says refresh tokens let clients refresh silently, without giving a lifetime. `skills/project-setup.mdx:94` says "thirty days idle".
- **Source**: `ai-implement/.env.example:159-160` — refresh tokens last 30 days and rotate on use. The "idle" phrasing was not confirmed against the token code, so the two pages may disagree on idle versus fixed lifetime.

### M-3: Marketplace catalog pins `v1.0.0`  (1/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `skills/installation.mdx:29` says adding `BuildDownAI/skills` with no ref gives the stable channel, "the most recent released version".
- **Source**: `skills-source/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json:12` — at the v1.4.0 tag the plugin entry's `ref` is `v1.0.0`, while `plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json:4` is `1.4.0`. Whether the catalog is re-pinned at release time was not confirmed from the checkout.

## LOW-priority findings (aggregate, numbered as L-1, L-2, ...)

- **L-1** — `reference/admin-ui.mdx:414` describes the `protect-custom.yml` check as "currently advisory" and flagging upstream PRs generally; the workflow runs only on PRs targeting `main` (`ai-implement/.github/workflows/protect-custom.yml:6-7`). Not reader-impacting. (2/3 runs)
- **L-2** — Orchestrator variables in `.env.example`, workflow-header variables, and `RepoMapping` fields all appear on their docs pages with matching defaults; no gaps found. (1/3 runs)
